address.label: Shezan Cakes and Snacks, Mallepally
address.formal_address: 11, 3-913/1, Jamia Masjid Rd, Mozampura, Mallepally, New Mallepally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001

distinguishing_features: Sits directly on a traffic circle/roundabout — not a straight stretch of road
Commercial bakery storefront right at the edge of the circle
Clear 'Shezan Cakes And Snack' branding and display counters visible from the street

approach_from.direction_label: Coming from Amba Hospital / New Riyan Hotel side (northwest)
approach_from.instructions: Head down Raj Janaki Prasad Road until you reach a large roundabout/traffic circle. The shop is right on the circle.

approach_from.direction_label: Coming from Hadi Hospital / Moghal Ground side (east)
approach_from.instructions: Head down Jamia Masjid Road towards the roundabout/traffic circle — the shop is right on the circle, roughly opposite the side you're entering from.

approach_from.direction_label: Coming from Anwarul Uloom College of Pharmacy side (south)
approach_from.instructions: Head north until you reach the roundabout/traffic circle. The shop sits on the circle itself.

entrance_details.identifying_marks: Large 'Shezan Cakes And Snack' signage above the entrance
entrance_details.access_notes: Ground-floor commercial street access, direct walk-in during business hours — no gate, no security, no floor/unit navigation needed

trigger_conditions: Driver still can't locate the storefront after being guided through both approach directions
Driver reports the shop signage or the mosque is no longer visible/recognizable
